decisions.decision: Real mode bypasses bbox-driven gripper angle calculation, uses hardcoded spinbox defaults (0.375 open, 0.18 close)
decisions.rationale: yoloe-derived bbox dimensions are noisier than sim ground truth; a single hand-tuned pair is more reliable for repeated lego grasps. Sim mode unchanged (still uses dynamic BASELINE_JAW_GAP + JAW_GAP_RATE × angle).

decisions.decision: Per-joint Freedrive Recenter implemented as in-process jsr services (~/freedrive_one, ~/recenter_one, ~/cancel_freedrive_one) keyed by target_joint_name ROS param
decisions.rationale: Avoids the kill+respawn-jsr blackout from arm_trim.py for the 'fix wrist_roll calibration without restarting' use case. Live RViz mirroring throughout the operation.

decisions.decision: lerobot calibration JSON path is .../so_follower/, NOT .../so101_follower/ — empirically verified
decisions.rationale: lerobot 0.5.2's --robot.type=so101_follower flag configures the runtime robot CLASS but the JSON saves to so_follower/ regardless. A.5 mistakenly assumed they matched; A.10 reverted.

decisions.decision: URDF→lerobot JSON name map: gripper_joint → gripper
decisions.rationale: URDF/jsr/control_gui use 'gripper_joint' (URDF link convention); lerobot JSON uses 'gripper' (canonical name). Mirrors trajectory_shim.py:64's existing inverse map.

decisions.decision: All 7 GUI tabs wrapped in scrollable Canvas+Scrollbar via _make_scrollable_tab helper
decisions.rationale: Settings tab grew past one screen height; same pattern applied to FK/IK/Grasp/Quickstart/Real Test/RViz. Mouse-wheel events activate per-tab via <Enter>/<Leave> so cross-tab wheel doesn't stray.

decisions.decision: recenter_one Homing_Offset guard relaxed from ±2047 to ±4095
decisions.rationale: Original ±2047 came from a stricter Feetech datasheet interpretation (12-bit signed). Firmware empirically accepts up to ±4095 (one full encoder rotation). Tighter cap blocked legitimate big-correction recovery scenarios like reverting an over-rotated Freedrive.

context_notes: Today shipped 17 commits (13 A.* atomic + 1 chore + 1 UX scroll-all-tabs + 2 small follow-ups). Group A goal was 'polish before grasp testing' — fully complete except for the deferred grasp Z calibration (Task #19 in TaskList). Stack is running real mode end-to-end (control_gui, gravity_comp, trajectory_shim, jsr, camera_publisher, localize_aruco, localize_yoloe). Lerobot calibrate completed via the wrapper UI today; JSON values fresh. yoloe consistently detecting 2 reds + 1 blue + 1-3 greens in wrist FOV. Mid-motion tracking ~5-8° lag on most joints is normal physics, not a calibration issue. The Z gap (0.013 < 0.014) is suspiciously tight — likely yoloe reports lego top-Z slightly low or the floor check itself uses a too-strict margin. Mental model: real-world calibration parameters need the same 'spinbox override for hand-tuning' treatment as gripper open/close (A.12), since yoloe-derived absolute coordinates have small systematic biases that are easier to override than to fix at the source.
